headline: Skippy to Pranky
title: Pranky | How Skippy Evolves | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Skippy evolves into Pranky at level twelve, a very early evolution. Pranky is a Water Aniimo with one hundred and nine HP and ninety eight magic defense. At level twenty it can go further, either into Glacy or into Leafy. Lightning, Grass and Ice hit Pranky for extra damage. Which final form are you aiming for? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Pranky guide: Skippy evolves into Pranky at level 12; Pranky then evolves into Glacy or Leafy at level 20. HP 109, magic defense 98. Weak to Lightning, Grass and Ice. Checked on aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki in November 2026.
joke: Pranky loves staying wet, and honestly so does your Aniimo team.
